description: Use this when the person needs proof that a fax they sent was delivered, to keep or to pass on. The confirmation of a fax the person sent that was delivered: one page that says who received how many pages, from whom and when, which they can pass on. Answers a link that reads it, as a PDF, for a few minutes: give the person the link. Refused, saying why, for a fax not delivered.

fax_id.description: The fax, by its id, as send_fax gave it.

name: get_fax_confirmation

outputSchema.description: A delivered fax’s confirmation: one page that says who received how many pages, from whom and when, which you can pass on.

url.description: A link that reads the confirmation, a PDF of one page, for a few minutes.

title: Get a fax’s confirmation
